# The commands in confirm-tier-commands.txt that remove a Docker container
# (cameronsjo/cadence-hooks#1661). scripts/confirm-tier-compare.py fails when
# guard-container-rm's first attempt blocks a command not listed here, allows
# one listed here, or blocks a listed one on its second attempt.
docker rm web
docker rm -f web
docker rm -fv web db
docker rm --force web
docker container rm web
docker container rm -f web
docker container remove web
docker --context prod rm web
docker -H tcp://h:2375 rm web
sudo docker rm web
DOCKER_HOST=tcp://h:2375 docker rm web
docker ps -aq | xargs docker rm
docker rm $(docker ps -aq)
docker stop web && docker rm web
bash -c 'docker rm web'
